summary.en:
- Hypercarry-focused support that excels alongside summon-based DPS units. His skill provides DMG%, CRIT Rate%, and cleanses, while also advancing both an ally and their summon(s), when applicable. If the target has a summon(s), they receive a larger DMG% buff.
- His Ultimate grants "The Beatified" state to an ally, increasing their CRIT DMG% and energy, and causing his Skill to refund Skill Points if used on them.
- Synergises best with summon-based units but remains effective in CRIT-based Hypercarry teams. However, he is limited to single-target support and cannot advance Harmony units, limiting his usefulness in certain compositions.
-  It's also worth noting that Sunday's buffs given to summons are dispelled when the summon disappears. Remembrance Memosprites are the only summons that can disappear, which can lead to a clunky synergy with Sunday if they disappear frequently.

details.en:
- S1 [[light-cone:a-grounded-ascent]] allows Sunday to use his Ultimate every 3 turns while also making him Skill Point positive. Provides up to a 45% DMG buff, which is sufficient to support most hypercarry teams.
- E1 provides a strong single-target DEF Ignore buff to the target of his Skill if they possess a summon. The ally target receives a 16% DEF ignore, while their summon gains an even stronger 40% DEF ignore buff.
